title.zh: Tether Froze $42.4 Million Three Months Before A Seizure Warrant, Lawsuit Says
title.en: Tether Froze $42.4 Million Three Months Before A Seizure Warrant, Lawsuit Says

current_state.zh: Tether is being sued for freezing $42.4 million in USDT three months before a seizure warrant was issued, according to a Manhattan federal court complaint.
